newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunisia seeks up to 12,000 tonnes soy/rapeseed oil.
newsitem.headline: Tunisia seeks up to 12,000 tonnes soy/rapeseed oil.

text.p: Tunisia will tender on Thursday for the purchase of up to 12,000 tonnes of soy and/or rapeseed oil for December 1996 and January 1997 delivery, the state-buying body Office National de l'Huile told Reuters.

ONH said on Wednesday the tender was for one or two lots of 3,000 or 6,000 tonnes to be delivered on 5-20 December 1996, and one or two lots of 3,000 or 6,000 tonnes for delivery on 5-20 January 1997.
Delivery is at two of the following three Tunisian ports -- La Goulette, Sousse and Sfax.
